title_ar: الشيخ  الددو يزور العلامة الدكتور يوسف القرضاوي - حفظهما الله تعالى
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Visits the Learned Dr Yusuf al-Qaradawi — may God the Exalted preserve them both
body_ar: الشيخ الددو يزور العلامة الدكتور يوسف القرضاوي - حفظهما الله تعالى أدى صباح اليوم الاربعاء 04 نوفمبر 2020م فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو زيارة أخوية لفضيلة العلامة الدكتور يوسف القرضاوي - حفظهما الله تعالى و قد تناول الشيخان هموم الأمة و ما تمر به من أحداث و ما يجب على العلماء فعله تجاه تلك الاحداث و سبل نصرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم و ختم فضيلته الزيارة بالتماس الدعاء من الشيخ.
body_en:
Sheikh al-Dedew visits the learned Dr Yusuf al-Qaradawi — may God the Exalted preserve them both.

On the morning of today, Wednesday 4 November 2020, the eminent Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew paid a fraternal visit to the eminent and learned Dr Yusuf al-Qaradawi — may God the Exalted preserve them both. The two shaykhs took up the concerns of the Ummah and the events it is passing through, what it is obligatory (wājib) for the scholars to do in the face of those events, and the ways of coming to the Prophet's aid (peace and blessings be upon him). His Eminence closed the visit by asking the Shaykh for his prayers.

flags.note: EDITORIAL. Yusuf al-Qaradawi is a contested figure: he was barred from entry by several Western states and is treated as a designated or proscribed individual in some jurisdictions. Nothing in this record is anything more than a report of a courtesy visit between scholars, and it has been translated exactly as it stands, neither softened nor strengthened. Published in English without context, however, an approving item about visiting him carries reputational exposure for the project in Western jurisdictions. The decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh’s office (style guide section 12).

flags.arabic: و سبل نصرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
flags.context: one of the topics the two scholars are reported to have discussed
options: the ways of coming to the Prophet’s aid (a neutral rendering of نصرة)
the ways of defending the Prophet (against insult)
the ways of supporting the Prophet’s cause
flags.note: نصرة النبي is a set phrase whose force depends on the occasion. The item gives no occasion, and the record does not say what the two scholars proposed. Option 0 is kept because it adds nothing the Arabic does not say; options 1 and 2 each import a context the source withholds.

translator_notes: A news item, not a fatwa. The body opens by repeating the article title verbatim — CMS furniture inside the body — which is preserved in body_ar and carried over in body_en rather than silently dropped (style guide section 11).

date_is_cms_upload is set FALSE for this record, unlike most of this range. The timestamp (5 Nov 2020, 09:13) is one day after the visit the body dates to "today, Wednesday 4 November 2020", which is the normal interval for a news item and not the minutes-apart clustering that marks the bulk uploads elsewhere in 1105-1210. The event date and the record date therefore differ by one day, and the body is the authority for the event date.

ما يجب على العلماء فعله is rendered "what it is obligatory (wājib) for the scholars to do", per the fixed five-rulings mapping (style guide section 3). This is the report’s characterisation of the conversation, not a ruling issued by the Sheikh.
The source writes الاربعاء and الاحداث without hamzah. Preserved as found.
